subject: Request: Incident response docs & summary for May 3rd service disruption
messages:
From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@paymentsco.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@paymentsco.com
Date: 2026-05-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Incident request: May 3rd outage — need IR docs & evidence

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the quick sync this morning. Our audit team has requested official incident response documentation for the May 3rd service disruption. Specifically they need:

- Formal IR plan (latest copy)
- A timeline of events (detected, mitigations, resolution)
- Any evidence/extracts (logs, alert screenshots, mitigations run) supporting the timeline
- Confirmation whether any customer data was impacted or exfiltrated
- Mapping to SOC 2 controls and SIG/CAIQ answers where relevant

Can you confirm whether you can provide a consolidated package by EOD Thursday, May 6? If not, please provide a preliminary timeline and an ETA for the full package.

Also copying our procurement contact so they have visibility to any DPA/SLA follow-ups.

Appreciate it — this will go straight into our vendor attestation file.

Best,
Alice

Alice Wu
Security Program Manager
PaymentsCo

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@paymentsco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-05T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Incident request: May 3rd outage — need IR docs & evidence

Hi Alice,

Thanks — we can do that. I've attached a preliminary timeline (prelim-incident-timeline.pdf) and a small runbook bundle (runbooks.zip) that show the initial triage steps.

High level for now:
- Detection: 2026-05-03T02:43 UTC — automated alert for elevated 5xx rates on inference-nodes
- Triage & mitigation: 02:45–03:15 UTC — circuit-breaker enabled; traffic shifted to failover pool
- Full remediation: 03:40 UTC — patch deployed and KV cache cleared; gradual restoration
- Customer impact: transient increased latency and a small window of elevated error rates; no confirmed data exfiltration

Monica (security ops) will compile the evidence bundle and a SOC2 control mapping. Markus will add ops remediation notes.

We will deliver the full evidence bundle and a short incident summary by EOD May 6. Let me know if you need a customer-facing notification draft as well.

Thanks,
Rachel

Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: prelim-incident-timeline.pdf (18 KB), runbooks.zip (script + md)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood-inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-05T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Incident request: May 3rd outage — evidence and control mapping

Rachel / team,

I'm assembling the artifacts now. Preliminary notes (will be included in the final package):

- Root cause: misconfiguration in the autoscaling policy combined with a rare race that allowed orchestration retries to saturate a subset of inference hosts. Patch: tighter orchestration backoff + feature flag to prevent retry storms.
- Impact: short window (~25 minutes) with increased 5xx errors for ~1.2% of requests. No auth token leakage; IAM audit shows no anomalous key usage. We have log slices (auth, network, process) from 02:40–04:00 UTC.
- Evidence: alert screenshots, aggregated slow-query logs, orchestration logs, process dumps (redacted), and remediation playbook run logs. Package name: ir-evidence-bundle.tar.gz
- SOC2/CAIQ mapping: I will attach a mapping table referencing CC7 and CC8 controls where remediation and monitoring are relevant.

Jira: IR-4723 contains the ticketed remediation work and remediation owner assignments.

I'll push the full bundle to the shared Drive link and send the link in the final email.

-Monica

Monica Patel
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will follow) ir-evidence-bundle.tar.gz (expected ~12MB)

From: Alice Wu <alice.wu@paymentsco.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@paymentsco.com
Date: 2026-05-05T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Incident request: May 3rd outage — need IR docs & evidence

Thanks Rachel — that timeline looks helpful. A couple quick follow-ups:

1) For our audit we also need a brief one-paragraph customer-facing summary we can place in our vendor registry. Can you provide wording that confirms no customer data was exfiltrated?
2) Please include any retained logs or retention policy notes that show how long you retain request/response logs and under which controls they are accessible.
3) If you can add a short section on lessons learned and planned preventative controls, that would close our auditors' checklist.

If you don't have the finalized drive link yet, a quick ETA is fine.

Regards,
Alice

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood-inference.com>
To: Alice Wu <alice.wu@paymentsco.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood-inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood-inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-06T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Incident summary and evidence package — May 3rd outage

Alice,

Attached is the final incident package and links:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cIR-Packages (contains timeline, logs, SOC2 mapping, and evidence bundle)
- JIRA: IR-4723 (remediation ticket and owners)
- Attachments: final-incident-package.zip (includes redacted logs, playbook run outputs, and a control-mapping spreadsheet)

Summary (customer-facing):
"On 2026-05-03 Redwood Inference experienced a transient service disruption impacting a small subset of inference requests. The issue was caused by an orchestration retry condition that saturated a subset of hosts; mitigation actions restored normal service within 60 minutes. We confirm that no customer credentials or customer data were exfiltrated during the incident."

Lessons learned / preventative actions (high level):
- Adjust orchestration backoff and add rate-limiting at the ingress to prevent retry amplification
- Add canary rollout gating for autoscaling config changes
- Expand alerting to include retry storms and host saturation thresholds
- Quarterly tabletop exercises for on-call + security to validate playbooks

Let us know if your auditors need additional artifacts (hashes for logs, longer retention samples, or an engineer call). Happy to set up a short walkthrough next week.

Thanks,
Rachel

Rachel Kim
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: final-incident-package.zip (3.1 MB)
